## Summary

Aaron Aznar is a Senior Product Designer based in São Paulo, Brazil. His work focuses on Product Design, UX Strategy, Design Systems, Design Tokens, UX/UI, digital products and Artificial Intelligence applied to design workflows.

He has 18+ years of experience in digital design, 30+ digital projects, 65 mapped skills and 32 public LinkedIn recommendations. His background includes Accenture Brasil, Ticket, Apontador MapLink, CreativeBizz and Universidade Positivo.
